plaatsen.tekst: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
